sentences.en: Do you really want to go to the pep rally?
sentences.zh: 你真的想去参加加油集会吗？

sentences.en: The Tokyo Stock Exchange rallied at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 东京证券交易所收盘时反弹了。

sentences.en: The king's subjects rallied around him in his hour of need.
sentences.zh: 国王的臣民在他最需要的时候团结在他的周围。

senses.zh: 团结；集合；恢复健康、力量等
